endpoints.purpose: IDE outbox to durable inbox; exact ack
Dashboard BFF and MCP read identical persisted projection

command.intentRef: An immutable server-held workflow intent with approved input/secret references, never an arbitrary shell command or credentials in the MCP request.
command.idempotency: Bind orgRef + projectRef + principal + idempotencyKey to canonical intent digest; same intent returns same receipt, conflicting intent is rejected.
command.approval: Server-held approval binds principal, exact intent, limits, expiry and scopes. Client flags, a model response and Autopilot are not an approval.
command.continuation: A new idempotent command references a committed parent result; uncertain external effects require reconciliation, never blind retry.
command.uiRequirement: Hide or disable execution when capabilities report writesEnabled=false. Show prepared/blocked, never success from a local proposal alone.

production.backend: Firebase/GCP pending authorized resources and transactional adapter

secrets: Operator secret references only; no browser bearer tokens, prompts, file paths, lease tokens or credentials in public projection, MCP results or this manifest.
